recent_excerpts: G7 and CISA advisory urges organizations to start migrating to post-quantum cryptography now, citing 'harvest now, decrypt later' risks and a 2035 UK roadmap for completion.
CVE-2026-60004, a 9.8-CVSS Gitea RCE, is under active attack per CISA. Attackers with repo write access can run shell commands. Patch now.
At Black Hat USA 2026, officials and researchers warn AI-driven vulnerability discovery outpaces defenses.
